card.name: Inside myelosuppression and similar terms
card.fires_on: The 'os' in 'myelosuppression' (and 'open' in 'leukopenia') in drug-label warnings. It also fires on small words like 'on', 'one' and 'each' in a programming exercise about printing characters per line.

modes.label: Character-per-line exercise
modes.description: Small words in a programming task about showing 16 ASCII characters on each line.
modes.example: Write a program that uses a loop to display the characters for each ASCII code 32 through 127. Display 16 characters<< on>> each line with one space between characters.
